review: Numerical PDEs and Spatial Discretization rendering audit
screenshot_review: Every assigned frozen title and complete ItemBody was reviewed against its assigned screenshot tile(s), with each PNG opened separately at original resolution; no collage or downscaled view was used. Multi-tile items were checked across their sequential captures. No clipping was confirmed: apparent cutoffs at tile boundaries continue in the next receipt-listed capture. The confirmed raw-math finding is content formatting, not clipping.

rendering_findings.excerpt: Line 30 uses `osc_C(g)=sup_{y,z∈C}|g(y)−g(z)|`; line 46 writes the cellwise integral identity and estimate as unformatted prose notation.
rendering_findings.symptom: The item shows mathematical expressions as literal ASCII identifiers, underscores, braces, and operators in prose while the adjacent displayed estimate and other body formulas are typeset. The original-resolution tile makes the mismatch clear.
rendering_findings.suggested_repair: Typeset the definition and proof expressions with inline math delimiters; retain the same mathematical content.

diagram_candidates.why: The item relates the discrete gradient-curl-div sequence to the simplicial cochain complex through degrees-of-freedom isomorphisms, then separates the curl and divergence kernels into exact-image and harmonic components. A diagram can show the parallel complexes, commuting isomorphisms, and where the harmonic spaces appear; the formulas and statements are already explicit, so this is editorial rather than a confirmed omission.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw: Two rows: W_h^0 → N_h^1 → N_h^2 → N_h^3 with ∇, curl, div; C^0 → C^1 → C^2 → C^3 with δ^0, δ^1, δ^2. Add vertical degrees-of-freedom isomorphisms and mark commuting squares. A separate kernel decomposition callout should show ker curl = ∇W_h^0 ⊕ H_h^1 and ker div = curl N_h^1 ⊕ H_h^2, with H_h^1,H_h^2 labeled by H_1,H_2 dimensions. Indicate contractible-mesh exactness as a conditional note, not a general conclusion.

existing_diagram_checks.check: The displayed map order is W_h^0 → N_h^1 → N_h^2 → N_h^3 with ∇, curl, div, matching the cochain row C^0 → C^1 → C^2 → C^3 with δ^0, δ^1, δ^2. No existing TikZ/tikzcd diagram or map-direction inconsistency was found.

diagram_review: No TikZ or tikzcd source diagrams occur in the 113 assigned items or their captured HTML (capture metadata reports zero). The discrete de Rham diagram candidate is optional and source-supported; other material did not warrant a concrete missing diagram. No existing diagram required clipping, overlap, or local-crop review.
clipping: No confirmed clipping. All 166 original-resolution tiles were opened individually. Long items continue across consecutive fixed-height captures; apparent boundaries were checked against subsequent tiles.
reference_titles: Wikilink targets appear as separate block lines, as expected. No reference-title leak or unexpected item-ID text was observed beyond the item identifier header.
technique_banners: Uppercase technique labels are expected CSS banners. No rendering defect was identified in them.
